props.description:
Represents the actual physical inventory materials that have been allocated and loaded for consumption during active production. This model tracks specific inventory lots, serial numbers, and consumption status for materials required by production processes.

This is a transient model, items are added and removed here throughout the production run. Once an item has been completely consumed, the record should be deleted from this table.
